acceptance_criteria.criterion: index.html contains a FOUC-prevention inline <script> in <head> that sets data-theme="dark" synchronously when no saved preference exists or when saved preference is "dark".
index.html nav contains <button id="theme-toggle" class="theme-toggle" aria-label="Toggle dark mode">.
app.js contains a Theme IIFE exposing init() and toggle() methods.
Theme.init() is called before Router.init() in the app.js bootstrap section.
Click listener on #theme-toggle is wired to Theme.toggle.
Clicking the toggle button flips data-theme on <html> and saves the selection to localStorage under key mcp-theme.
Reloading the page after toggling restores the selected theme (persistence).
When localStorage has no mcp-theme key, dark mode is active on page load (default).
The toggle button is keyboard-accessible: activatable via Space/Enter, has aria-label.

summary: All implementation was already present in the target files. Both index.html and app.js fully satisfy all 9 acceptance criteria.
index.html: FOUC-prevention inline <script> is in <head> after styles.css, defaulting to dark mode unless 'light' is saved. Toggle <button id='theme-toggle'> is in the nav.

app.js: Theme IIFE (var Theme) with init(), toggle(), and _apply() is declared before the Router IIFE. Theme.init() is called before Router.init() in the bootstrap section. The click listener on #theme-toggle is wired inside Theme.init(). Toggle flips data-theme on <html> and persists to localStorage key 'mcp-theme'. Button aria-label is updated on each toggle.

comments.note: No observations — implementation is clean and consistent with the WP-002 spec. The Theme IIFE uses a private _toggleBtn reference and a shared _apply() helper, which is slightly more efficient than the spec's const-based approach but fully equivalent in behavior.

summary: All 9 acceptance criteria verified against source code. index.html: FOUC-prevention inline script in <head> correctly defaults to dark (saved !== 'light'), toggle button present in nav with correct id/class/aria-label. app.js: Theme IIFE exposes init()/toggle(), init() wired before Router.init() in bootstrap, click listener attached inside init(), toggle() flips data-theme and persists to localStorage key 'mcp-theme'. CSS has [data-theme=dark] variable overrides and .theme-toggle::before shows contextual moon/sun icons. No regressions detected.

comments.note: The toggle button uses CSS ::before emoji content (🌙/☀️) for its icon — this means the button appears visually empty if CSS fails to load. For a local GUI tool this is acceptable; a text fallback inside the <button> element would be more resilient but is not required by the spec.

aria-label is updated dynamically by Theme._apply() to contextual 'Switch to light/dark mode' values. The initial HTML value 'Toggle dark mode' is non-directional but is immediately overwritten by Theme.init() before user interaction — no functional issue.
No observations beyond the above — implementation is clean, logically consistent, and fully satisfies all acceptance criteria.

summary: Reviewed mcp-server/gui/public/index.html and mcp-server/gui/public/app.js against all 9 acceptance criteria.

index.html: FOUC-prevention inline script correctly sits in <head> after stylesheet; synchronous execution prevents any flash. The saved !== 'light' guard is logically consistent with init()'s (saved === 'light') ? 'light' : 'dark' expression. Button has correct id/class/aria-label.

app.js Theme IIFE: Clean module pattern with private _toggleBtn reference. _apply() correctly uses removeAttribute for light mode (consistent with [data-theme=dark] CSS selector). toggle() reads current theme from DOM rather than cached state — avoids state drift. Null-guard on _toggleBtn in _apply() is correct; toggle() is only reachable through the listener which is itself guarded. Bootstrap: Theme.init() precedes Router.init().
One minor finding: <button id='theme-toggle'> lacks type='button'. Default type is 'submit' per spec; no form is present so there is no functional risk, but explicit type='button' is best practice.
All 9 acceptance criteria confirmed met. No regressions. Implementation is clean and minimal.

comments.note: mcp-server/gui/public/index.html line 25: <button id='theme-toggle'> is missing type='button'. Although no <form> ancestor exists (eliminating submit risk), the HTML spec defaults <button> to type='submit'. Adding type='button' is best practice and removes any ambiguity for future refactors that might wrap nav content in a form.

Key test cases: (1) first load with no localStorage key → dark mode active; (2) click toggle → switches to light and saves 'light'; (3) reload → light persists; (4) click toggle again → dark and saves 'dark'; (5) keyboard: tab to button, press Space/Enter → toggles theme.
